claims: Braga has over 2,000 years of history
Bom Jesus do Monte is a UNESCO World Heritage site
Bom Jesus do Monte is known for its baroque zig-zagging stairway leading to a church
Braga Cathedral (Sé de Braga) is the oldest cathedral in Portugal
Santa Bárbara Garden is a public garden located next to the Medieval Archbishop’s Palace
Braga is often called the "City of Archbishops"
Braga is home to the University of Minho
Braga was originally a Roman city called Bracara Augusta
The municipality of Braga has a population exceeding 190,000
Braga is roughly 1 hour from Porto
